faq.question: What do logistics, fleet & aviation organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 6 logistics, fleet & aviation use cases. The most common are work & project management (4), operations & ERP (4), CRM (3), most often for operations & delivery, sales & CRM, customer service teams.

faq.question: How long does a logistics, fleet & aviation monday.com build take?
faq.answer: The most common timeframe for a complete logistics, fleet & aviation build is under 6 weeks. Phased programs run longer, with later phases added once the core build is adopted.

faq.question: Which systems do logistics, fleet & aviation builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in logistics, fleet & aviation use cases are Make, Xero, Legacy grain storage/logistics system, monday API, HubSpot.

useCases.title: Grain container packing and export business
useCases.summary: Orders were re-keyed manually into a legacy grain logistics system, duplicate seal numbers risked compliance fines, and clients lacked visibility of order status.
useCases.challenge: Orders were re-keyed manually into a legacy grain logistics system, duplicate seal numbers risked compliance fines, and clients lacked visibility of order status.
boards: Order board with container and seal number capture
Pivot-style reporting and external client portal views (Enterprise)
Client repository board with email/activity tracking per order
automations: Order status change → client and internal notifications
Button trigger → validated order data pushed to the legacy grain management system via API
New seal number → duplicate check with team alert before submission (Make.com)
Structured CSV export for legacy-system import
useCases.outcome: An API integration pushing validated orders into the legacy system, duplicate seal detection, client notifications and pivot reporting, delivered either by Fruition or alongside the client's developer.

process.title: Validated container orders pushed to legacy logistics system
